Northstar Clinical Technologies

Context layer pilot scaffold is ready for review.

This packet creates a comprehensive synthetic Northstar substrate and a deterministic ingestion scaffold that shows how uploaded files are classified, parsed, validated, approved, committed, and made available to agents. It is designed as a high-fidelity pilot narrative for a large clinical technology company with ERP complexity, regulated QMS obligations, financial pressure, and AI product modernization.

Company Profile

Scale

Northstar is modeled as a newly independent global clinical technology company with 85-country reach, 42 plants, 14 R&D hubs, 6 business units, and a $1.15B IT budget.

FDA QSRISO 13485EU MDRSOXGxPHIPAA-adjacent

Why This Pilot Matters

The business story is deliberately hard: prove a post-carveout operating model, exit TSAs, sequence SAP/ERP modernization, protect QMS evidence, rationalize product complexity, and make regulated AI product modernization board-defensible.

Pilot Story

The demonstration is not "we loaded a spreadsheet." It is a visual story: Northstar uploads real enterprise artifacts, AbarVa maps them into a governed context layer, stewards approve or reject facts, and agents start answering with source locators instead of generic prose.

1. UploadCMDB, ERP workbook, financial reports, QMS events, strategy memos, vendor contracts, and org exports.
2. Parse + MapClassifier picks a context dimension and extraction strategy, then maps fields to canonical facts.
3. Approve + SyncValidation findings route facts to owner approval before they become agent-available.
4. ReasonSentinel, Source, Moves, and Tower can cite uploaded facts, freshness, confidence, and owner role.

Upload / Approval / Sync

The scaffold includes deterministic ingestion primitives under src/lib/context-ingestion/ plus a route at /api/context-ingestion/northstar.

StageBehaviorProof in This Packet
ClassifyUses file extension and filename semantics to choose context dimension and extraction strategy.CMDB CSV maps to application_portfolio; strategy PDF maps to c_suite_strategy.
ExtractStructured CSV/JSON use deterministic row extraction; PDF/DOCX/PPTX are marked as hybrid / LLM-needed.Smoke asserts row/page source locators and confidence values.
ValidateRequired fields, numeric fields, time-classification enums, and owner gaps produce findings.Malformed CMDB row flags invalid enum and invalid number.
ApproveValid facts are approved; validation-error facts remain uncommitted.Smoke asserts approved fact count equals committed fact count.
CommitCommitted facts build evidence rows and become available to agents.API smoke returns committed facts and evidence rows.

Agent Use Cases

The verification target includes 36 canonical questions. Examples include:

  • What do you know about Northstar?
  • Where is the fastest path to $250M margin expansion?
  • Should we accelerate global SAP S/4 consolidation?
  • What blocks shutting down JD Edwards in Dental?
  • Which vendor contracts should Source renegotiate first?
  • Which VP or director chain blocks plant MES harmonization?
  • How did AbarVa ingest Northstar data?
  • Which uploaded facts were rejected?

Known Gaps

  • The Northstar data is file-backed and verified; loading it into Azure Postgres as durable tenant rows is a follow-up.
  • The ingestion scaffold marks PDF/DOCX/PPTX as hybrid / LLM-needed; production OCR and AI extraction should route through the egress wrapper in a hardening slice.
  • The admin pages are visual process/read-model surfaces; full storage-backed upload/versioning UX is not included in this scaffold.
  • Actual Clerk user creation is intentionally not run during this code change; the five personas are wired for provisioning through existing scripts.
